name: Sicily
about: Peak summer (Jul–Aug) is scorching and packed, spring and fall are the better window for touring.
overview: Greek temples, Baroque towns, and an active volcano you can hike (and, oddly, ski on), with a food culture shaped by 3,000 years of Mediterranean crossroads.
costOverview: Espresso and a casual lunch both stay properly cheap — even the major archaeological sites charge modestly by European standards.

specialSeasons.text: Holy Week (Easter) processions, especially Trapani's multi-day Processione dei Misteri, are among Sicily's most striking traditions — dates shift with the Easter calendar.
